user.title: Connect to EnergyID
user.description: Create a personal API key with read access to records in your EnergyID account settings.

meters.title: Choose meters
meters.description: Hourly statistics are imported for every selected meter.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate EnergyID
reauth_confirm.description: The API key for {record} was rejected. Enter a new key with read access to this record.

reconfigure.title: Replace the API key
reconfigure.description: Enter a new API key with read access to {record}.

error.invalid_auth: The API key is invalid or lacks read access.
error.record_not_found: This API key has no access to the configured record.

abort.no_records: This API key has no access to any record.
abort.no_meters: This record has no meters that can be imported.
abort.invalid_auth: The API key is invalid or lacks read access.

init.title: Choose meters
init.description: A newly selected meter imports its history on the next sync. Statistics of a deselected meter are kept.

abort.invalid_auth: The API key is invalid or lacks read access.

stale_data.title: No recent EnergyID data for {meter}
stale_data.description: The newest imported hour for {meter} is more than {days} days old. EnergyID may no longer receive data from Fluvius: the Fluvius mandate in EnergyID expires after three years. Renew it in your EnergyID record.

no_data.title: No EnergyID data for {meter}
no_data.description: EnergyID returned no data points for {meter}. Check in EnergyID that the meter receives readings.

meter_removed.title: EnergyID meter {meter} is no longer available
meter_removed.description: The selected meter {meter} no longer exists in the record or can no longer be imported. Remove it from the meter selection in the integration options.

sync.name: Sync now
sync.description: Fetches the latest EnergyID data for a record and updates its statistics.

rebuild_statistics.name: Rebuild statistics
rebuild_statistics.description: Fetches a meter's data again and rewrites its statistics from a date onwards.

start_date.name: Start date
start_date.description: First day to rebuild. Without a date the rebuild starts at the beginning of the imported history.

entry_not_loaded.message: The EnergyID record is not loaded.

not_a_meter.message: The selected device is not an EnergyID meter.

sync_failed.message: The sync with EnergyID failed. Check the logs for details.
